instructions.description: Instructions explaining observer's evaluation screen and pay-off structure for voters based on observer's belief about voter type (quadratic scoring rule, 2*X points)

screens.description: First screen of a committee member (voter): shown own type (L) and ball color (RED), then asked to report signal to other voter via straw-poll announcement (blue / red / abstain)
Second screen of a committee member (voter): free-form chat interface for type communication (σ-chat) with the other voter; timer visible; other voter's indicated ball color shown
Third screen of a committee member (voter): review of chat transcript, then final simultaneous voting decision (blue / red) to keep status quo or overturn
